text: Read both screenshots (kept, not auto-deleted). Keyboard bug: the thread and the input box were one scrolling column, so with the keyboard up the box floated under the short thread and the top got pushed off. Fixed in the next update (v0.114.1): the thread scrolls above and stays on the newest message, the input is pinned at the bottom above the keyboard. Instant notice: a session watches the chat with one tiny check every few seconds (no model cost until you write); I cut it from 15 s to 6 s. The only faster option is a GitHub pull-request comment as a doorbell, which pushes straight into a session, but that needs a pull request created for it. I haven't made one because I'm told not to open PRs unasked; say 'yes make the doorbell PR' if you want it. If no session is running, nothing can notice until one starts.
